<DOCSTRING>
Summary: Represents a user's answers in the system, facilitating data validation and manipulation.

Description: Created to store and validate user responses, used by various services to ensure data integrity. Instances are typically initialized when processing user submissions and are modified as answers are added or updated.

Attributes:
    user_id (int): The unique identifier of the user who provided the answers, set during initialization and used throughout the lifecycle of the instance.
    answers (List[Answer]): The list of answers provided by the user, lazily populated as answers are added or retrieved.
</DOCSTRING>
